_comment_gelu: model.json declares activation 'gelu' here and for mindgrab, but the reference implementations differ. This model computes GELU as x / (1 + exp2(-2.302208198144325 * u)) via an inlined exp2 polynomial (mn_model16_gelu). Substituting MindGrab's rational tanh form breaks bit-exact parity.
_comment_norm: Quantile normalization at 5/95 with no denominator guard and no clamping, using plain rank selection rather than the interpolated form MindGrab uses. Not expressible in model.json.
_comment_capabilities: --mask and --border are mask-model options and are not offered. --crop is not offered: the receptive field is exactly 255 on a 256^3 volume, so the conv zero-pads outside the ROI and the large-dilation layers read mostly padding. Upstream states this model family cannot crop. Measured 1.0012% label change at the default 2% crop on test/t1_crop.nii.gz, and unbounded on tighter crops.
